verdict.rationale: Delegating tasks to built-in AI agents is the platform's core offering. Users can task Kosmos, Literature, Analysis, Precedent or Molecules with research objectives, and Kosmos autonomously reads literature, runs code, forms hypotheses and returns cited, auditable reports. The docs also cover task submission, batch and async jobs, follow-up questions, and long-lived chat sessions that keep their sandbox and history. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks perform as claimed, and explicit documentation of delegating through the in-product web UI (the evidence is mostly about the API client).
